content.cn: 不允许使用任何插件读取内存，只允许使用 D 服专用地板读取器，以防止作弊。
content.en: Plugins that read game memory are not allowed. Only the Destiny-specific floor reader may be used, to prevent cheating.

content.cn: 每个账号每天可获取一个箱子（有概率获得超级装备）；每个 IP 每天最多获取两个。超出的箱子会被 GM 回收。
content.en: Each account can receive one box per day, with a chance to contain super equipment. Each IP is limited to two boxes per day. Extra boxes will be reclaimed by a GM.

content.cn: 允许同时运行多个客户端，账号数量不限，但仅限在账号之间转移道具；不允许多开同时刷图，否则可能封号。
content.en: Running multiple clients is allowed, with no account-count limit, but only for transferring items between your own accounts. Do not run multiple clients to farm simultaneously; doing so may result in a ban.

content.cn: D 服角色能力上限较高，其他服务器的配点方案可能不兼容。请参考 200 级配点攻略。
content.en: Destiny characters have higher stat caps, so builds from other servers may not be compatible. See the level-200 build guide.

content.cn: 请勿在游戏内持续辱骂、攻击他人或进行诈骗。D 服允许充值购买装备，请谨慎交易。
content.en: Do not repeatedly insult or attack others in chat, and do not scam. Destiny allows equipment purchases with donations, so trade carefully.

content.cn: 游戏内交易通常在 Discord 社区交易区进行；也可以委托群友或直接与群友交易。
content.en: In-game trades are usually arranged in the Discord community's trading channel. You may ask a community member to help or trade with them directly.

summary.cn: 在角色仓库与公共仓库之间切换。
summary.en: Switch between your character bank and the shared bank.

cn: 公共仓库由同一账号下的所有角色共享。
en: The shared bank is accessible to every character on the same account.

summary.cn: 从当前任务传送至大厅。
summary.en: Return to the lobby from your current quest.

cn: 仅在执行任务时有效。
en: This command only works while you are on a quest.

summary.cn: 查看当前生效的每日任务及其剩余时间。
summary.en: Check the active daily quest and its remaining time.

cn: 每日任务会掉落每日宝箱。若你位于正确的任务地图并使用此指令，系统会显示“激活”状态。
en: The daily quest drops a daily box. If you are in the correct quest area, this command shows the quest as “active.”

summary.cn: 修改角色的颜色编号；# 为 0 到 9。
summary.en: Change your character's Section ID. Replace # with a number from 0 to 9.

cn: 使用后请切换场景或重新登录，避免玛古喂食异常。
en: After changing your ID, switch areas or log in again to avoid Mag-feeding issues.

summary.cn: 显示当前已使用的各类能力药数量。
summary.en: Show how many of each type of Material you have used.

summary.cn: 重置能力药使用计数；# 为 1 到 5。输入后需切换场景生效，并需执行两次确认。
summary.en: Reset a Material usage counter. Replace # with 1–5. Switch areas for the change to take effect; run the command twice to confirm.

cn: 1：攻击；2：精神；3：回避；4：防御；5：运气。
注意：无法重置 HP / TP 药的计数。
en: 1: Power; 2: Mind; 3: Evade; 4: Defense (Def); 5: Luck.
HP and TP Material counters cannot be reset.

summary.cn: 使用特殊装扮；# 为 0 到 11。
summary.en: Apply a special character costume. Replace # with a number from 0 to 11.

cn: 使用前请先前往更衣室，将头部/发型更换为第一个型号。
0：默认（原角色）；1：忍者；2：暗影；3：索尼克；4：纳克鲁斯；5：塔尔斯；6：大叔（EP2）；7：艾莉（EP2）；8：桃子（EP4）；9：艾米；10：公会/仓库职员；11：希尔弗。
en: Before using this command, visit the dressing room and set the head/hair model to the first option.
0: Default; 1: Ninja; 2: Shadow; 3: Sonic; 4: Knuckles; 5: Tails; 6: Uncle (EP2); 7: Elly (EP2); 8: Momoka (EP4); 9: Amy; 10: Guild/Shop Staff; 11: Silver.

summary.cn: 更改肤色；# 为 1 到 4。仅适用于机器人职业以外的角色。
summary.en: Change your skin tone. Replace # with 1–4. This only works for non-CAST classes.

summary.cn: 更改面部造型；# 为 1 到 5。仅适用于机器人职业以外的角色。
summary.en: Change your face style. Replace # with 1–5. This only works for non-CAST classes.

summary.cn: 将当前房间密码修改为 #。
summary.en: Set the current room password to #.

summary.cn: 将当前房间名称修改为 #。
summary.en: Set the current room name to #.

summary.cn: 随机掷出 0 到 100 之间的数字，并向房间内所有成员显示。
summary.en: Roll a random number from 0 to 100 and show it to everyone in the room.

summary.cn: 查看当前大厅或房间内所有玩家的公会名片。
summary.en: View the Guild Cards of all players in the current lobby or room.

summary.cn: 屏蔽指定玩家；# 为其公会名片编号。
summary.en: Ignore a player. Replace # with their Guild Card number.

cn: 如需解除屏蔽，请在账号设置中清除屏蔽列表。
en: To unblock a player, clear the block list in your account settings.

summary.cn: 按 Tab 键查看当前房间的颜色编号。
summary.en: Press Tab to view the Section ID color of your current room.

summary.cn: 双倍掉率活动进行时，查看剩余时间（分钟）。
summary.en: While Happy Hours is active, check how many minutes remain.

summary.cn: 经验加倍活动进行时，查看剩余时间（分钟）。
summary.en: While an XP Boost is active, check how many minutes remain.

summary.cn: 显示房间详细信息：经验倍率、掉落倍率、房主 ID 颜色段及难度。
summary.en: Show room details: EXP and drop rates, host ID color, and difficulty.

summary.cn: 显示封印物品当前的击杀总数。
summary.en: Show the current kill count for a sealed item.

cn: 若击杀数已满但物品尚未解封，请尝试切换场景。
en: If the required count is reached but the item has not unlocked, try switching areas.

summary.cn: 在头顶显示彩色箭头；# 为颜色编号。
summary.en: Display a colored arrow above your character. Replace # with a color number.

en: 0: None; 1: Red; 2: Blue; 3: Green; 4: Yellow; 5: Purple; 6: Cyan; 7: Orange; 8: Pink; 9–11: White; 12: Black; 13 or higher: No arrow.

summary.cn: 按指定类型自动设置控制器配置。
summary.en: Automatically configure a controller profile by type.

cn: 1：原生 PS4 控制器；2：Xbox One 控制器（即将推出）；3：Xbox 360 控制器。
使用 DS4Windows 等驱动程序时，请选择 3（Xbox 360）。
en: 1: Native PS4 controller; 2: Xbox One controller (coming soon); 3: Xbox 360 controller.
If you use a driver such as DS4Windows, choose 3 (Xbox 360).

intro.cn: PSOBB Destiny 服务器 200 级全职业配点攻略
intro.en: PSOBB Destiny Server: Level-200 Builds for All Classes

content.cn: D 服全部职业属性上限上调，很难让所有属性都达到黄字，因此需要有所取舍。优先级：命中（ATA）> 攻击（POW）/精神（MIND）> 幸运（LUCK）。防御力和回避力可按剩余药位及个人喜好补充。
content.en: Destiny raises the stat caps for all classes, so reaching yellow numbers in every stat is difficult and requires trade-offs. Priority: Accuracy (ATA) > ATP (POW) / MST (MIND) > Luck (LUCK). Use remaining Material slots for DFP or EVP according to preference.

content.cn: 大部分职业可以通用 0/130/70/0 属性的 MAG，但这不是最佳方案。
content.en: A 0/130/70/0 MAG can work for most classes, but it is not an optimal build.

content.cn: V802（加速插件）：施法速度 +100%，本攻略默认 FO 全程佩戴。V503（属性增强）：提升 ATP 等属性。抗性装方案若计入 V503 提供的 ATP，可能导致攻击（POW）无法达到黄字，因此本表不将其计入计算。
content.en: V802 (cast-speed unit) increases casting speed by 100%; this guide assumes Forces wear it at all times. V503 (stat-boosting unit) increases ATP and other stats. Since counting its ATP can prevent POW from reaching yellow numbers in resistance builds, it is not included in the calculations below.

content.cn: 本方案为官方/资深玩家推荐路线，并非强制标准，请根据实际战斗需求决定是否采用。
content.en: These builds are recommendations from the server and experienced players, not requirements. Choose a build that fits your combat needs.

cn: 推荐 HP 1930（需 96 个 HP 药水），是触发无敌的最佳选择。
en: Recommended HP: 1930 (requires 96 HP Materials); an excellent choice for triggering invincibility.

cn: D 服 HUcast 攻击力黄字高达 1800，此方案最后还差 5 点才变黄。若要最大化攻击力，建议增加 V503 或减少运气药。
en: Destiny HUcast reaches 1800 ATP at yellow numbers, and this build falls 5 points short. To maximize ATP, add V503 or use fewer Luck Materials.

cn: 推荐 HP 1930（需 31 个 HP 药水），是触发无敌的最佳选择。
en: Recommended HP: 1930 (requires 31 HP Materials); an excellent choice for triggering invincibility.

cn: 装备 Immortal/Ability 可达成全属性最大化，但并非必要。
en: Immortal/Ability can maximize all stats, but it is not required.

cn: 精神力差 84 点达到最大值；无 V802 无法装备 SKYFALL。
en: MST is 84 points below its maximum; SKYFALL cannot be equipped without V802.

cn: 攻击力差 83 点达到最大值。
en: ATP is 83 points below its maximum.

cn: 精神力差 80 点达到最大值；无 V802 可装备 SKYFALL。
en: MST is 80 points below its maximum; SKYFALL can be equipped without V802.

cn: 攻击力差 79 点达到最大值。
en: ATP is 79 points below its maximum.
